# vendor/studio

`mcp_server/` is copied unchanged from **StudioApprentice studio** (Kunal Gupta),
branch `dev`, commit `5d74fdf`, with permission: `serve_mcp.py` (the
screen / focus / click tools), `act_win32.py` (real Windows input) and
`screen.py` (screen capture). Deskhand runs them in-process; studio itself is
not needed.
